identity.title: Weekly Bookkeeping Habit for Micro-Business Owners

course.claim: Owner can close out a week's cash-in/cash-out ledger in under 20 minutes without an accountant.
course.non_claims: Does not cover tax filing, payroll, or formal audited statements.

live_problem.situation: Owners track sales on scraps of paper or memory and discover cash shortfalls months later with no way to trace them.
live_problem.purpose: Owner closes a simple weekly ledger routinely enough that a shortfall is caught within the week it happens.

learner.prior_knowledge: Comfortable with a smartphone; has never used a ledger app or spreadsheet for the business.
learner.barriers: No spare weekday time; must be fully async, self-paced, spread over several weeks to become a habit, not a one-off lesson.

opens: a shortfall found in week 1 is fixable; one found in month 11 is not

routes.question: Does cash-on-hand match the ledger's running balance at week's end?
routes.criteria: reconciled balance matches counted cash within a small stated tolerance

capability.overall: Owner can close a weekly cash ledger and spot a shortfall the same week it occurs.
capability.human_return: Given a week of real transactions, owner enters them and reconciles cash-on-hand within 20 minutes without help.

content.must_know: The three ledger fields (in, out, running balance) and where cash-on-hand should match.
content.must_do: Actually enter one real week of transactions and reconcile.

sessions.learner_action: Owner logs each real sale/expense into the app as it happens for one week.
sessions.evidence: 7/7 days have at least one logged entry

sessions.learner_action: Owner closes the week's ledger and counts physical cash-on-hand to compare.
sessions.artifact: closed weekly ledger with reconciliation note
sessions.evidence: balance reconciled within stated tolerance, unassisted, in under 20 minutes

assessment.claim: Owner can independently close a weekly ledger.
assessment.task: Close out one real week of transactions in the ledger app.
assessment.observation: Time taken and whether the reconciled balance matches actual cash-on-hand.
assessment.criteria: Closed within 20 minutes, balance matches cash-on-hand within a small tolerance.
assessment.warrant: A real week closed correctly and on time is the exact behavior this course exists to build into a habit.
